</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2022-01-01to2022-12-31" escape="true" name="us-gaap:SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_800_eus-gaap--SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock_zwpZ64DM5STf" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><b>Note 21 &#8211; <span id="xdx_828_z8TB7ces3og4">Segment information</span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">The Company presents segment
information after elimination of inter-company transactions. In general, revenue, cost of revenue and operating expenses are directly
attributable, or are allocated, to each segment. The Company allocates costs and expenses that are not directly attributable to a specific
segment, such as those that support infrastructure across different segments, to different segments mainly on the basis of usage, revenue
or headcount, depending on the nature of the relevant costs and expenses. The Company does not allocate assets to its segments as the
Chief Operating Decision Maker (&#8220;CODM&#8221;) does not evaluate the performance of segments using asset information.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">The Company evaluates performance
and determines resource allocations based on a number of factors with the primary measurements being revenues and income/loss from operations
of the Company&#8217;s two reportable segments: 1) Medical Services and 2) Property Management Services.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

Dr. Chen has agreed to forfeit and surrender <span id="xdx_902_ecustom--OrdinarySharesForfeited_iI_c20230516__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SettlementAgreementMember_zxsJuOxCsBAk" title="Ordinary shares forfeited"><ix:nonFraction name="EUDA:OrdinarySharesForfeited" contextRef="AsOf2023-05-16_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember_custom_SettlementAgreementMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">271,867</ix:nonFraction></span> ordinary shares of

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="background-color: white">Between

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">On June 8, 2023, the Company
and the Seller 1 and Seller 2 (together, the &#8220; Sellers&#8221;) entered into amendments to the Prepaid Forward Agreements (together,
the &#8220;Amendments&#8221;), to amend the definition of &#8220;Maturity Consideration,&#8221; such that, Maturity Consideration shall
consist of <span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--OrdinarySharesToBeIssued_iI_c20230608__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember__srt--TitleOfIndividualAxis__custom--SellerOneMember_zERqaZKpCb72" title="Ordinary shares to be issued"><span id="xdx_908_ecustom--OrdinarySharesToBeIssued_iI_c20230608__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember__srt--TitleOfIndividualAxis__custom--SellerTwoMember_zt5U0FtuUMcj" title="Ordinary shares to be issued"><ix:nonFraction name="EUDA:OrdinarySharesToBeIssued" contextRef="AsOf2023-06-08_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember_custom_SellerOneMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares"><ix:nonFraction name="EUDA:OrdinarySharesToBeIssued" contextRef="AsOf2023-06-08_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember_custom_SellerTwoMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">800,000</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></span></span> ordinary shares of the Company to be issued to the Sellers by the Company. Pursuant to the Prepaid Forward Agreements,
the maturity date of the Prepaid Forward Transaction 1 and 2 (together, the &#8220;Prepaid Forward Transactions&#8221;) (the &#8220;Maturity
Date&#8221;) may be accelerated by the Sellers after any occurrence wherein during any 30 consecutive trading-day period, the dollar volume-weighted
average price of Company&#8217;s ordinary shares for 20 trading days is less than $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--SharePrice_iI_c20230608__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zXUEz4uhktu3" title="Share price per share"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SharePrice" contextRef="AsOf2023-06-08_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember_srt_MaximumMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">3.00</ix:nonFraction></span> per share. Pursuant to the Amendments, the parties
agreed that the Prepaid Forward Transactions shall be accelerated as of the date of the Amendments, and accordingly, the <span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesIssued_iI_c20230608__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember__srt--TitleOfIndividualAxis__custom--SellerOneMember_zKT4Dq40Cy5j" title="Ordinary shares issued"><span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesIssued_iI_c20230608__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember__srt--TitleOfIndividualAxis__custom--SellerTwoMember_zzSp6mQhPTc8" title="Ordinary shares issued"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued" contextRef="AsOf2023-06-08_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember_custom_SellerOneMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued" contextRef="AsOf2023-06-08_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember_custom_SellerTwoMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">800,000</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></span></span> ordinary
shares (or <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesIssued_iI_c20230608__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zkLrsvQOtkB9" title="Ordinary shares issued"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued" contextRef="AsOf2023-06-08_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">1,600,000</ix:nonFraction></span> ordinary shares in the aggregate), became immediately due and payable to the Sellers upon execution of the Amendments.
The Amendments provide the Sellers with registration rights for the ordinary shares issuable as Maturity Consideration, and also prohibit
the Sellers from selling such ordinary shares on any exchange business day in an amount greater than <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20230608__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_zkt7DP8QMf0h" title="Debt instrument trading percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage" contextRef="AsOf2023-06-08_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember_srt_MinimumMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">15</ix:nonFraction></span>% of the daily trading volume of
